issues: React a11y warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' and 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' — several DialogContent usages have no Description (a11y only, does not affect functionality). Consider adding DialogDescription or VisuallyHidden wrapper.

action_items: Optional a11y polish: add DialogDescription (or VisuallyHidden aria-describedby) to Sheet/Dialog components in HeaderMenu.jsx and TabPustaka.jsx to silence Radix accessibility warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly wraps Gemini via emergentintegrations.LlmChat with a fallback to _fallback_card on any exception — that fallback sets sumber='offline' so it's traceable. Good.
Base64 validation in /api/bimbing uses base64.b64decode(..., validate=True) — correctly returns 400 on malformed payload.
MongoDB client is instantiated but no collection is actually written/read; keep an eye for scope creep or remove if never used.
No _id serialization issue because no Mongo docs are returned.
Frontend TabFoto.submit sends `image_base64` as full data URL (with data:image/jpeg;base64, prefix). Backend _bersihkan_base64 strips this correctly.
